description.narrative: IFC anticipates that the Project will increase access to patient management and analytics software for healthcare operators in emerging markets. The Companys platform unifies patient data within and across systems of healthcare providers and payers, and provides advanced analytics and actionable insights for value based care and population health management. By combining multiple data sources on a single platform, the Project has the potential to result in productivity gains for healthcare operators and improved health outcomes for patients. The Companys plan will be supported by an IFC upstream advisory project that facilitates its entry in emerging markets. The main sources of expected market creation outcomes involve increased integration of local healthcare value chains, through substantially strengthening digitization, via enabling frameworks.

The proposed Project is an equity investment of up to US$20 million in Innovaccer, Inc. (Innovaccer or the Company), a privately held corporation domiciled in the US with operations in India, the US and the Middle East. Founded in 2014, Innovaccer is a leading healthcare Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company which is creating the missing interoperability and intelligence layer to convert electronic medical records (EMRs), lab data, insurance claims information, pharmacy reports and other social determinants of health into actionable insights to improve population health management and deliver better health outcomes in a cost-efficient manner. Innovaccer has helped its customers unify health records for 50 million+ people and generate approximately US$1.5 billion in cumulative cost savings.
